referenceFunction.generalComment: The data represent the PWB of a power supply unit, used in modern Desktop PCs. Material data are based on own dismantling activities. Infrastructure and production efforts are based on own assumptions. An update was made in 2023, comprising: modification to energy consumption and regionalization of inventory flows, such as energy and metal input (Duque Ciceri et al., 2010; Kupka et al., 2018.); Geography: Data represent a global valuable composition of PWB in a power supply unit.; UUID: da8cea40-719e-3ad9-a1b6-00b04b73639b
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset covers component input and production efforts (incl. PWB waste due to failure in mounting) for the production of a PWB used in the power supply unit of a desktop PC, using Pb-free solder material.
